meta.name: alterlab-rfdiffusion
meta.description: Generate de-novo protein backbones with RFdiffusion (Watson 2023) — a diffusion model for unconditional monomer generation, motif scaffolding, binder design against a target, and symmetric oligomers. Use when generating a new protein backbone from scratch, scaffolding a functional motif into a fold, designing a binder backbone to a target surface, or building symmetric assemblies; RFdiffusion produces the STRUCTURE, then alterlab-proteinmpnn designs its sequence and alterlab-alphafold validates it. For sequence design of an existing backbone prefer alterlab-proteinmpnn (or alterlab-ligandmpnn with a ligand); to fold a known sequence prefer alterlab-alphafold; for generative multimodal design prefer alterlab-esm. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 能用 RFdiffusion 生成全新的蛋白质骨架结构（3D 坐标），包括单体、带功能基序的支架、与靶标结合的配体骨架以及对称多聚体。输出的是不含序列的 PDB 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要从头设计蛋白质结构、将功能基序嵌入新骨架、设计与靶标蛋白结合的配体骨架，或构建对称多聚体时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个 100 个氨基酸的蛋白质骨架。
say.note: 无条件生成单体，输出 PDB 文件。

say.text: 以这个 PDB 中的结合位点为基序，设计一个支架蛋白。
say.note: 基序支架：固定功能区域，生成周围骨架。

say.text: 针对这个靶标蛋白设计一个结合配体的骨架。
say.note: 配体设计：生成与靶标表面结合的骨架。

howto.what_en: Claude uses RFdiffusion to generate novel protein backbone structures (3D coordinates), including monomers, motif-scaffolded folds, binder backbones against a target, and symmetric oligomers. Outputs backbone PDBs without sequence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design a protein backbone from scratch, scaffold a functional motif, design a binder backbone to a target surface, or build symmetric assemblies.

say_en.text: Scaffold a binding motif from this PDB into a new fold.
say_en.note: Motif scaffolding: fix motif, generate surrounding backbone.

say_en.text: Design a binder backbone against this target protein.
say_en.note: Binder design: generate backbone docked to target surface.
